_comment: Sample live state for previewing the book. Not published and not part of book.json. Each top-level key is a db collection the page reads (status, run, log) and each inner key a document id, in the shapes from references/data-model.md. Use it two ways: (1) node scripts/build.mjs examples/sample-book --demo examples/sample-book/db-seed.json embeds it, and the page shows it, labelled as sample data, only when the db is not available; (2) after a real publish, write the same documents with ArtifactData to see the live page. It says: wave 1 is built, reviewed and verified except the PDF worker, which waits for its pull request review in wave 2; wave 2 is building; wave 3 has not started.
